newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Seven peasants gunned down in northern Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Seven peasants gunned down in northern Colombia.

text.p: Unidentified gunmen killed seven peasants in northern Colombia in the latest of a string of massacres reported over the last month, authorities said on Wednesday.
They said the seven peasants, all males, were gunned down Tuesday in a rural area of the municipality of Fundacion in Magdalena Province, near the birthplace of Nobel laureate Gabriel Garcia Marquez.

Army Col. Carlos Sanchez, who confirmed the peasant killings in an interview with the Caracol radio network, said it was not immediately clear if they were the work of leftist guerrillas or a right-wing paramilitary group.
